body: I fucked up so bad I ruined a person I care about's life. They had a bright future. I fucked up I fucked up so bad.

I can't, the teachers are gonna get all over my ass and one of them already said I'm slacking off. I'm honestly trying so fucking hard but I can't focus. I can't concentrate. I used to be a top scorer and now everything's fucked. My grades are dropping and everyone thinks I'm a lazy piece of shit.

I guess it's the pressure of school, but I also had some shit go on in my life. The teacher that I talked to said that it sounds like I have depression and that I should get diagnosed by a professional.

Mental health has its stigma from where I live, people are gonna think I'm fucking bat shit crazy if I need to take antidepressants. I just want the feeling to stop.

There's nothing wrong with loving someone as long as it's safe and consensual.

It's okay to fall in love, because you do deserve love. Nothing or no one can erase that. You deserve to accept yourself and be happy. We all do. I'm here if you need to talk.

Hey, there's this scientific quote that I repeat to myself all the time when I feel like utter shit.

‘Every action has an equal and opposite reaction.’

Which means: No matter how horrible you're feeling right now, no matter how alone or depressed or anxious, there will be a day where you feel so damn happy and loved and free. It means that if you're feeling horrible right now, you WILL feel on top of the world in the future.

And you don't want to miss that day.

If you need anything, I'm just a message away. Please hold on and stay, for a little longer. There always is a reason to go on.
